bundle_provenance.author: OpenCode (AI-authored)
bundle_provenance.evidence_method: Source/manual audit; contracts-exoml/obligations.json; tests/fixtures/contract_semantics.c. Elements are bytes, never implicitly owned objects.

provenance.author: OpenCode (AI-authored)
provenance.evidence_method: Initialize only fresh/freed storage; init does not release an existing live buffer

invalidations.description: Successful growth may invalidate all data/element borrows. No growth preserves them; failure preserves data, capacity and length.

provenance.author: OpenCode (AI-authored)
provenance.evidence_method: mulib_vec_reserve checks stride/state/overflow before realloc commit

parameters.name: element
parameters.encoding: v->stride trivially-copyable bytes; may alias a live vector element

invalidations.description: Growth invalidates old element borrows; internal source is rebased before copy. Failure preserves existing elements and length.

provenance.author: OpenCode (AI-authored)
provenance.evidence_method: mulib_vec_push offset/rebase/memmove; never recursively retains pointed-to resources

invalidations.description: Any buffer growth may move storage.
vec_free releases the buffer, not the v struct.
Pop/clear invalidates logical borrows of removed elements, even if bytes remain allocated.

provenance.author: OpenCode (AI-authored)
provenance.evidence_method: mulib_vec_at returns data+index*stride or NULL; vector must have valid initialized invariants

parameters.name: out_element
parameters.encoding: optional caller buffer of v->stride bytes; NULL discards

invalidations.description: Only the removed logical element expires. On empty vector, output is not initialized.

provenance.author: OpenCode (AI-authored)
provenance.evidence_method: mulib_vec_pop copies raw bytes with memmove; no pointee ownership transfer is inferred

invalidations.description: All logical elements are removed; capacity/buffer persist and nested resources are not destroyed.
All buffer borrows expire. Initialized struct retains stride and can be reused; nested pointees are not freed.

provenance.author: OpenCode (AI-authored)
provenance.evidence_method: mulib_vec_free frees data then init(v,v->stride); repeated free on initialized struct is harmless
